note: Common Paper publishes no key terms sheet for the BAA. These fields are the substitution points its Standard Terms already name; the labels and hints are ours.

sections.title: The agreement this attaches to
sections.hint: A BAA never stands alone. It sits on top of the contract under which the services are already being provided.

fields.label: Underlying agreement
fields.hint: The contract this BAA supplements, named so there is no doubt which one it modifies.
fields.placeholder: the Cloud Service Agreement dated 1 March 2026

fields.label: BAA effective date
fields.hint: When these HIPAA obligations start. It need not match the underlying agreement's own start date.

fields.label: Breach notification period
fields.hint: How quickly the provider must report a use or disclosure of PHI that this BAA does not permit.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.hint: Limits on what the provider may otherwise do with PHI — subcontracting, de-identifying, aggregating, or processing it outside the United States.
fields.placeholder: PHI may not be processed outside the United States
